policy: Keep explicit platform/API/hardware packages; replace browser and home with reviewed components; omit vendor preinstall entirely.
notes: VpnDialogs, PacProcessor and ProxyHandler are platform facilities; their presence does not establish a configured proxy or VPN.
FileBrowser declares no INTERNET permission in this original manifest and preserves local USB file access.
Google services, Play, bundled entertainment, mirroring, network remote input, factory test, OEM updater, old WebView and old home are omitted.
Runtime API compatibility, absence of unsolicited traffic and physical video playback require device testing.
Original framework/native libraries are retained for this experimental build; this is not a full AOSP source rebuild or a malware-free certification.
